Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Invoice.name: Invoice
Invoice.comment:
An invoice with two Workflows, whose Timers names the one it reads:
an issued invoice unpaid for thirty days is overdue.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

fields.name: payment
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: paymentEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

InvoiceChange.name: InvoiceChange
InvoiceChange.comment: The writes of Invoice's rows its behaviors hear, one message per write, whoever makes it, which a trigger of the table writes and a behavior worker runs (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Invoice row written.

fields.name: write
fields.description: What the write did: insert, update or delete.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the write was made, in epoch milliseconds, by the database's clock.

fields.name: before
fields.description: The row's columns before the write, by column, as JSON; null for an insert.

fields.name: after
fields.description: The row's columns after the write, by column, as JSON; null for a delete.

InvoiceDeadline.name: InvoiceDeadline
InvoiceDeadline.comment: The deadlines Invoice's behaviors arm, one message per row, use and deadline, due when it falls due (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Invoice row the deadline is armed on.

fields.name: useId
fields.description: The id of the use that armed it: its anchor field, or the behavior's name for a use the table implements.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The deadline's name, the use's own.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was armed to fall due, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: What the use armed it with, which its deadline hook reads.

InvoiceTimersDeadlines.name: InvoiceTimersDeadlines
InvoiceTimersDeadlines.comment: One row per deadline started on the row, keyed by the deadline's name: the time it starts from, the fact it started from, when it is due (null once until cancelled it), whether and when it fired, and what its then met.

fields.name: invoice
fields.description: The Invoice row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The deadline's name in the config.

fields.name: baseAt
fields.description: The time the deadline starts from, in epoch milliseconds: the create's, the status's entry's, or the field's.

fields.name: armedFrom
fields.description: The fact it started from, as text: the create's or the entry's time, or the field's value. A write that leaves it as it is arms nothing.

fields.name: dueAt
fields.description: When it is due, in epoch milliseconds; null once until cancelled it.

fields.name: fired
fields.description: Whether it fired.

fields.name: firedAt
fields.description: When it fired.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: What its then met when it fired: moved, skipped, vetoed or forbidden.

Ticket.name: Ticket
Ticket.comment:
A support ticket (D103): its status is a Workflow, and Timers holds it to
its SLA. The first answer is due 1.5 seconds after the create, and a
ticket still open then escalates; one left waiting on its customer an
hour closes; and a reminder falls due a day before a visit.
